tools.name: search_award_availability
tools.description:
Query the AwardSecrets data set (award-travel intelligence, AI-augmented and derived from GDS inventory and lived award-travel experience; not scraped) for award (points/miles) seat availability on ONE route, ONE date and ONE airline. Returns the flights found with cabin and seat count.

IMPORTANT —

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_award_availability, how_to_book_with_points · Private data: search_award_availability, how_to_book_with_points · Public sink: how_to_book_with_points.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_award_availability, how_to_book_with_points · Private data: search_award_availability, how_to_book_with_points · Public sink: how_to_book_with_points

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
